subject: Exec workshop: deck slotting, run-of-show gaps, and exec briefing ownership
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Sarah Huang <sarah.huang@greyco.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Draft slots + asks for exec briefing (workshop week of 6/22)

Team / Sarah —

Thanks for the sync earlier. Attaching the latest consolidated agenda (GF-Agenda-v3.pdf) and a one-sheet speaker index so we can quickly map owners to intake items. High-level asks before Monday's run-through: 

1) Slot confirmation: please review page 2 of the agenda and confirm the 10/35/15 pacing (intro / breakout / demo) for your blocks. We need hard slot owners by EOD Monday so ops can lock AV.

2) Exec briefing: we need a 1-pager (Exec-briefing.docx) for leadership that summarizes business outcomes, success metrics, and two escalation openings. Markus — can you own the success metrics section?

3) Pre-read packaging: Laura, can you consolidate the pre-read bundle into a single Drive folder and add short TL;DRs for each doc? Attendees prefer a 2-minute skim per doc.

Attachments: [GF-Agenda-v3.pdf (7 pages)] [Speaker-Index.xlsx (tabbed)]

Thanks — I want the materials to land cleanly with GreyCo's execs next week.

Kimberly Park
Head of Events, Redwood Inference
redwood.ai

From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Sarah Huang <sarah.huang@greyco.com>
Date: Fri, 05 Jun 2026 11:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft slots + asks for exec briefing (workshop week of 6/22)

Kimberly —

I can take the success metrics piece. Quick notes after scanning the agenda: 
- The 35-minute demo slot on Day 1 looks tight if we want live inference under load. Suggest we add a 10-minute live-preview earlier (move a 15-min audience Q later).
- For the exec one-pager, I'll draft 3 bullets tying business outcomes to cost/latency improvements and a recommended next action (pilot -> Dedicated).

Also attaching a simple speaker readiness tracker (embedded in Speaker-Index.xlsx) with two fields: "must run slides by" and "hardware needs". Laura — can you add the pre-read links into that sheet so execs see the dependencies?

Attachments referenced: [Speaker-Index.xlsx — updated tab: readiness]

-Markus
VP, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Sarah Huang <sarah.huang@greyco.com>, Greg Patterson <gpatterson@sterlinghealth.io>
Date: Sat, 06 Jun 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft slots + asks for exec briefing (workshop week of 6/22)

Thanks — happy to own the pre-read bundle. I created a folder and added links into the Speaker Index as requested. Latest Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2c3ExecWorkshopAssets

I've added TL;DRs for three core docs:
- Implementation Brief (2 bullets: scope + timeline)
- Cost/Latency Snapshot (3 bullets: baseline numbers)
- Case Study (1 bullet: customer lift)

Question for Sarah / Greg: are there any governance docs you want included (data retention / audit logs)? If yes, send a single PDF and we'll slot it under "Security and Controls" so it appears before the live demo.

Also — I flagged two speaker slide owners who haven't uploaded to the shared drive: Priya N. (Quant) and Diego F. (Ops). Tessa — can you ping them next week for final slide drops?

-Laura
Sr. Program Manager, Events Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Huang <sarah.huang@greyco.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>, Greg Patterson <gpatterson@sterlinghealth.io>
Date: Mon, 07 Jun 2026 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Draft slots + asks for exec briefing (workshop week of 6/22)

Appreciate the quick turn. Quick answers from the GreyCo side: 
- Governance doc: yes — I'll upload a single PDF (Security-Control-FAQs.pdf) by Tuesday EOD. Please place under the security section.
- Slot preference: the execs want the live demo earlier in Day 1 (they want to see capability before the breakout). If you can move the demo to 11:15 that would be ideal.

Markus — your suggested 10-minute preview sounds perfect. If you tighten the demo pacing we can keep the Q&A at the end of the session.

Laura / Tessa — thanks for the TL;DRs. We'll review and surface any redlines by Thursday.

Sarah Huang
Director, Platform Strategy
GreyCo
